newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Optical Sensors reduced.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Optical Sensors reduced.

text.p: -- Volpe Brown Whelan & Co said analyst Philip Nalbone cut the rating on Optical Sensors Inc to neutral from buy.
-- the company said earlier Monday that it was recalling its blood gas monitoring product, SensiCath. Company said the recall resulted from blood chemistry changes after blood flowed by the sensor.
-- Volpe said it was suspending its estimates after the announcement of the recall.

-- In a research note, analyst said the development "is certainly a big setback for the company, and we think it could take several months after the product is returned to the market for the company to regain the confidence of customers and investors alike."
